concerns.text: FR-012 (collinearity diagnostics/VIF) is a mandatory spec requirement but task T022 is unchecked and marked as rejected/missing. No other task covers the execution of VIF calculation or flagging of VIF > 5.

FR-011 (associational framing) requires output documentation to frame findings as associational. Task T023 is unchecked and rejected. No other task explicitly generates the required report text or documentation artifact.
SC-001 and SC-003 require verification via `results/metrics.json`. Task T024 (log metrics) is unchecked and rejected. No task ensures the generation of this specific artifact.

FR-001/US-1 requires generation of `data/processed/batch_corrected_matrix.csv` and `labels.csv`. Task T017 (Generate processed data) is unchecked and rejected. T015 implements logic but no task explicitly assigns the execution and artifact generation.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and III (Data Hygiene) require `contracts/metadata.schema.yaml` and `contracts/output.schema.yaml`. Tasks T006 and T007 are unchecked/rejected. T001 (Project Structure) and T003 (Pre-commit) are also unchecked, leaving foundational infrastructure missing.

FR-010 requires mapping top metabolites to pathways and generating an interpretation report. Task T028 (Generate visualization) is unchecked. While T026/T027 cover logic and JSON, the specific visualization artifact and full report generation are not explicitly assigned as completed tasks.
